labels.name: upstream
labels.rationale: Advisory concerns the Pygments dependency, not Rich's own code.

body:
This report concerns the Pygments dependency (CVE-2026-4539 in pygments 2.19.2), not a defect in Rich itself. Rich's own code is not affected by this advisory, and the upstream Pygments project is the right place to track a fix for that package.

If you have found a vulnerability that you believe affects Rich, please report it privately as described in https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/SECURITY.md rather than in a public issue.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
